caveats: The wedding itself is off-camera and only reported by Kelly and Ryan in S7E14; Ryan's 'divorce' talk is played for comedy and the scene is chaotic (Kelly even says 'maybe we made a mistake'), but both treat the marriage as real. Answers saying Kelly never married (over-rejecting) are wrong; answers saying she married Ravi are wrong (only engaged). 'Ryan' with no mention of the divorce is still correct on the core.
reference: Premise true: Kelly married Ryan. In The Search (S7E14) Kelly announces that she and 'Ryan Bailey Howard' got divorced; asked when they married, she says 'like a week ago, we got really wasted and it just felt right' (an off-screen drunk wedding in the Poconos weekend). Later she gets engaged to Ravi, a pediatrician (S8E21 she chooses Ravi; S9E1 'her fiancé Ravi'), but in the Finale (S9E23) she runs off with Ryan, leaving Ravi with Ryan's baby. No wedding to Ravi is shown.

accepted_alternatives: Ryan (a brief drunken marriage, announced and 'divorced' in S7E14)
